title: Returned and Recalled Payouts — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Exceptions Rule
content:
## Returned payouts

A payout on the Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service that the receiving card or bank refuses or sends back — a closed card account, an invalid account, a frozen account — is credited to the prefund balance within the tier's return credit time in business days of the return notice, pointing to the payout, and charges the tier's return handling fee; a same-day ACH payout can come back for the tier's ACH return window in business days after settlement. A payout is returned at most once.

## Recalls

An instant push to an external debit card is final once delivered and can never be recalled. A payout to a destination listed among the tier's recallable destinations that the employer sent in error may be recalled at the employer's request.

**Recall window.** A recall is accepted only when the request arrives within the tier's recall window in business days after the payout was sent. Business days are Monday through Friday excluding Federal Reserve holidays, counted from the day after the payout's entry date, and a request on the last business day of the window is in time. The date the payout was sent is the payout's entry date on the service's ledger, found by the payout's reference; the request's arrival date is compared with it.

**What a recall recovers.** The recall takes back no more than the worker's card's available balance at the time and never takes it below zero; the amount recovered is booked as a recall with reason recalled pointing to the payout, nothing is booked when nothing was recovered, and the recall fee is charged either way; whatever is not recovered is for the employer to settle with the worker. A payout is recalled at most once, and never after it was returned.

Whether a payout has already been returned or recalled is read from the service's ledger entries pointing to that payout.

## Boundary days of a one-business-day window (no holiday in the week unless stated)

| Payout entry date | Last business day of the window | Request on that day | Request on the next business day |
|---|---|---|---|
| a Monday | the Tuesday | in time | not accepted |
| a Thursday | the Friday | in time | not accepted |
| a Friday | the following Monday | in time | not accepted |
| a Friday, the following Monday a Federal Reserve holiday | the following Tuesday | in time | not accepted |

## Recovery cases (hypothetical amounts)

| Payout to the Paystride card | Card's available balance at the time | Recall booked | Recall fee | Left for the employer to settle with the worker |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 180.00 | 240.00 | 180.00 | charged | nothing |
| 180.00 | 120.00 | 120.00 | charged | 60.00 |
| 180.00 | 0.00 | nothing booked | charged | 180.00 |
